title: EXPLOIT: Intro to the Cyber Range
description: A beginner-friendly, practical cybersecurity workshop. Explore how cybersecurity works through live demonstrations and interactive activities. No prior experience is required — just curiosity and a willingness to learn.
longDescription:
This workshop is designed to give first-year students a practical introduction to cybersecurity. You will explore real-world concepts, see live demonstrations, and get hands-on experience through interactive activities in a guided and friendly environment.

Phase 01 — Explore Cybersecurity
Get introduced to cybersecurity, discover its major domains and career paths, and learn which foundational skills to develop as a first-year student.

Phase 02 — Think Like an Attacker
Experience cybersecurity through practical demonstrations and understand how security weaknesses can be identified, why they matter, and how systems can be better protected.

Phase 03 — Your First Cyber Challenge
Put your thinking skills to the test through beginner-friendly cybersecurity challenges. Learn by exploring, solving problems, and discovering new concepts.
agenda: 10:30 AM: Keynote & Core Concepts | 11:30 AM: Live Cyber Range Attack/Defend Demo | 12:30 PM: Interactive CTF Mini-Wargame
